name: The shore
opening: Vale arrives at the empty station. Pip carries a black cloth. The keeper holds the oil. Each wants something different.

places.name: Empty station
places.text: The timetable lists years that have yet to happen.

places.name: Mirror attic
places.text: A tall mirror reflects a black shore.

places.name: Black pond
places.text: Something vast breathes beneath the reflection.

avatars.name: Vale
avatars.text: A traveller with a coat full of empty pockets.

avatars.name: Pip
avatars.text: A moth in a borrowed waistcoat.

avatars.name: The keeper
avatars.text: A tall figure with a clock for a face.

items.name: Lamp
items.text: A brass lamp, warm to the touch.

items.name: Bell
items.text: A small bell with a cracked lip.

items.name: Black cloth
items.text: A square of cloth darker than the room.

items.name: Green coin
items.text: Struck for a ferry that never ran.

shore-places.name: Reed bank
shore-places.text: Reeds lean toward anyone who stands still.

shore-places.name: Sunken platform
shore-places.text: A station platform rises from the water, its clock stopped.

shore-places.name: Lantern jetty
shore-places.text: Planks run out over black water and stop.

shore-places.name: Drowned waiting room
shore-places.text: Benches face a window full of water.

shore-places.name: Signal box
shore-places.text: Levers for lines that no longer exist.

finds.name: Brass key
finds.text: Too warm, as if just held.

finds.name: Folded timetable
finds.text: Every train on it leaves yesterday.

finds.name: Wet ticket
finds.text: Single, one way, to the pond.

finds.name: Brass lens
finds.text: Everything through it looks further away.

finds.name: Coil of rope
finds.text: Damp, and longer than it should be.

finds.name: Tin whistle
finds.text: It plays one note, and the note echoes.
